newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish prime minister wishes Tony Blair well.
newsitem.headline: Polish prime minister wishes Tony Blair well.

text.p: Polish Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz on Friday congratulated his new British opposite number Tony Blair and wished him every success, PAP news agency said.
"Please accept my sincere congratulations and best wishes for you, your government and the British nation," Cimoszewicz wrote in his message, PAP said.
Cimoszewicz, who was on a visit to Washington when the British election results were published, said he learnt of Blair's landslide victory "with satisfaction" and hoped to meet him soon.
